statistics: Descriptive medians; two startup pairs/head, three requests per service/case. No population noninferiority or invented tolerance. Plain has one sequential startup pair.
first_request_scope: fullON block1 no longer has a same-process quality prelude; original11 quality belong to the cleanly stopped separate service. subsetON block1 retains11quality prelude. Keep every first-request marker and this asymmetry.
material_scope: Reused acceptance fixtures explicitly selected by this frozen plan; not a novel holdout. Legacy case.json performance_acceptance_sample only recognizes the old held_out_acceptance role spelling and stays false for reused_acceptance_fixture. Raw labels are retained; actual block kind, diagnostic_only=false, identities and frozen plan define the present comparison.
work_scope: Source/log-derived entire generation counts, excludes prefill and init; not pure GPU time. Post-TTFT client throughput has a different window.
cost_scope: Index lifecycle includes init+query+append+release. numeric_ns includes lazy decode/lookup/allocation and is already within query_ns; never add twice.
old_evidence_scope: Previous target/draft oracle limited to two GDN/captured draft/synthetic EOS; no universal equality claim. Existing GPU timing used only for unchanged operator understanding, not new B timed intervals.

resources.scope: Physical RAM total is system MemTotal-MemFree, including file cache and shared host activity; do not add CUDA/host/RSS, which overlap this total. Deltas do not isolate suffix attribution. Process deltas are sparse CPU ticks/IO across interior samples, not pure submission or GPU wait. Polling cannot exclude sub-interval interference.
